01.text: Good morning. I’m Maya from Atlas Office Supplies.
01.speaker: A

01.text: Nice to meet you. What does your company sell?
01.speaker: B

01.text: We supply stationery, printers and office furniture to local businesses.
01.speaker: A

01.text: Could you send me your catalogue and a quotation?
01.speaker: B

02.text: Could you supply fifty units of item A twelve by the fifteenth of March?
02.speaker: A

02.text: Yes. The unit price is eight euros, plus shipping.
02.speaker: B

02.text: Please confirm the delivery date in writing.
02.speaker: A

02.text: We confirm your order for fifty units. Delivery is expected on the fifteenth of March.
02.speaker: B

03.text: My parcel arrived damaged. One printer is broken.
03.speaker: A

03.text: I’m sorry to hear that. Could you provide your order number?
03.speaker: B

03.text: Of course. I’ll send a photo of the damaged item as well.
03.speaker: A

03.text: Thank you. We’ll review the details and contact you tomorrow.
03.speaker: B

04.text: Supplier B is faster, but Supplier A is cheaper.
04.speaker: A

04.text: Could you offer a five per cent discount for two hundred units?
04.speaker: B

04.text: We can offer a three per cent discount if you pay within ten days.
04.speaker: A

04.text: Thank you. Could you put those terms in writing?
04.speaker: B

05.text: Could you send us a quotation for one hundred units of model B four?
05.speaker: A

05.text: Certainly. Do you need shipping to Seville included?
05.speaker: B

05.text: Yes, please. Could you also confirm the estimated delivery date?
05.speaker: A

05.text: Of course. I’ll send you the quotation this afternoon.
05.speaker: B
